title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**SonicWall**
 is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. **www.sonicwall.com**

**Twitter**
,

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R324
  
  
As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
  
  
You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
  
  
Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
  
  
**The impact you will have**

* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.

title: Cloud Support Engineer, AI/ML (Night Shift)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
**Cloud Support Engineer — AI/ML & Programmability (Night Shift)**
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
Snowflake's Support team is expanding. We're looking for a Cloud Support Engineer who enjoys working with data and solving a wide variety of problems, drawing on hands-on experience across operating systems, database technologies, big data, data integration, connectors, and networking.
  
  
Our mission is to make Snowflake the preferred platform for running all AI, ML, data science, and data engineering workloads. You'll join a highly productive, fast-moving team supporting Snowflake Cortex and our ML product lines — work that is central to delivering on Snowflake's AI Data Cloud mission.
  
  
Snowflake Support is committed to providing high-quality resolutions that help customers deliver data-driven business insights and results. We are a team of subject matter experts working collectively toward our customers' success, building partnerships by listening, learning, and connecting.
  
  
Snowflake's values shape how we deliver world-class Support: putting customers first, acting with integrity, owning initiative and accountability, and getting it done.
  
  
As a Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be the technical partner our customers turn to for guidance on using Snowflake effectively. You'll also be the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams, surfacing feedback and improvements. Beyond individual cases, you'll help build knowledge across the team and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve how we work.
  
  
Depending on business needs, you may be assigned to one or more Snowflake Priority Support customers. In that capacity you'll develop deep familiarity with their use case and how they use the platform, delivering the service that enables them to get the highest levels of continuity and performance from their Snowflake implementation.
  
  
**AS A CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Drive technical solutions to complex problems, providing in-depth analysis and guidance to Snowflake customers and partners via email, web, and phone
* Adhere to response and resolution SLAs and escalation processes to ensure fast resolution of customer issues
* Investigate issues using the Snowflake environment, connectors, third-party partner software, and internal tools
* Troubleshoot customer use cases built on Snowflake's Cortex and ML stack, working across Python runtimes and relevant ML libraries
* Investigate, evaluate, and compare Large Language Models to help customers get maximum value from Snowflake's AI capabilities
* Work with customers to resolve programmability-related issues, including DevOps and Kubernetes
* Document known solutions to our internal and external knowledge bases
* Report well-documented bugs and feature requests arising from customer submissions
* Partner with engineering teams to prioritise and resolve customer requests
* Participate in a range of Support initiatives
* Provide support coverage during holidays and weekends based on business needs

**OUR IDEAL CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* 2+ years of experience in a technical support environment or a similar technical, customer-facing function
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail
* In-depth knowledge of at least one major cloud provider's ecosystem
* Working knowledge of Python and relevant ML libraries
* An intermediate understanding of LLMs and their enterprise applications
* Understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in a 24x7 support environment, including technical case escalation, incident management, and on-call rotations
* Background supporting an RDBMS, and familiarity with database release management
* Understanding of machine learning foundations — neural networks, statistics, and optimisation — and of optimising model performance, scalability, and efficiency
* Production experience with frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras
* Working experience with Jupyter Notebooks
* Experience with development tools and IDEs (Visual Studio Code, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA)
* Experience with API tooling such as Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, and API Gateway
* Experience with data visualisation tools — Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly
* Understanding of big data technologies such as Hadoop or Spark
* Understanding of event-driven architectures and microservices
* Knowledge of authentication and authorisation protocols such as OAuth and JWT

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* This role works the 4th / night shift, typically starting at 10:00 PM IST
* Participation in pager duty rotations during nights, weekends, and holidays
* Applicants should be flexible with schedule changes to meet business needs

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Join Barclays as a Lead AI Engineer role, where you will design and build core AI/ML solutions that power our enterprise AI capabilities. You will take ownership of significant AI subsystems — from agentic workflows and LLM applications to evaluation pipelines and MLOps tooling — delivering production-grade solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural vision. You bridge the gap between AI architecture and hands-on implementation, driving technical delivery while mentoring junior engineers. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

* Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related discipline
* 8+ years software engineering experience with at least 3 years building AI/ML systems, scalable ML infrastructure, or model serving platforms at enterprise scale
* Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, asyncio) and/or Go/Java, with production experience building APIs and microservices serving high-throughput, low-latency workloads
* Hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems and LLM applications including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, planning frameworks, and deployment of multi-step AI workflows
* Solid technical knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and modern agentic frameworks (Strands, LangGraph, Google ADK) with ability to build and optimise agent-based solutions
* Working experience with GenAI/LLM systems — prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model serving (vLLM), and OpenAI-compatible API surfaces
* Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture — microservices, cloud platforms, API design (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), and event-driven architectures
* Experience with AWS services — EC2/EKS, S3, IAM, RDS, and at least one AI service (Bedrock, SageMaker)
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes — containerising applications and deploying to orchestrated environments
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation, Terraform), and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing)
* Ability to work on system design from ideation through completion with limited supervision; effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**

* Experience building evaluation frameworks for agentic systems including agent benchmarking, reasoning traces, and monitoring observability for multi-step AI workflows in production
* Experience in vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and memory systems for stateful agents with understanding of retrieval optimisation and context management
* Experience implementing AI safety controls — content filtering, guardrails, prompt injection detection, PII redaction
* Knowledge of AI security frameworks — NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10
* Familiarity with model fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, RLHF, supervised fine-tuning) for domain-specific SLMs
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, and security considerations for autonomous systems
* Understanding of Zero Trust architecture and identity systems (EntraID, OAuth2/OIDC)
* Background in financial services — understanding of regulatory requirements, data residency, and compliance obligations
* Experience with GPU workload management and inference optimisation (vLLM)

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Bengaluru and Pune office.

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

* Collaborate with Ops and Service teams to continuously refine business rules, SOP changes, exception patterns, and process variations.
* Document process maps, domain rule books, interaction guidelines, and agent behavior specifications.

* Provide execution-level support to the Lead – Agentic AI Domain on coordinating and delivering Ops/Service/IT use cases

Suggestions for refining domain models, process rules, fallback logic, and decision pathways.
  
  

* Identification of high-priority exceptions, risk scenarios, or system-dependency constraints.
* Recommendations for data requirements, signal dependencies, or validation rules.
* Proposals for improvements based on test output, reasoning logs, and interaction outcomes

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
**In a nutshell**

Loylogic created the global rewards marketplace. Today, we are leading its evolution into the AI era - helping organizations recognize, reward and incentivize their most valuable customers, employees and partners with greater intelligence, relevance and impact.

Loylogic is looking for a highly hands-on AI Transformation Lead to help redesign how work gets done across our company. This is not primarily an AI strategy, research or advisory role. We are looking for a builder with a strong business and process mindset: someone who can quickly understand how work happens today, challenge it, simplify it and then use AI agents, automation and modern technology to make the better way of working a reality.

Working directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, you will have the opportunity to work horizontally across the organisation: Commercial - Sales, RevOps, Customer Success; Marketplace – Partnerships, Marketplace – Performance, Platform, and Corporate (Finance, PE, Legal). Our ambition is not to deploy AI for the sake of AI.

It is to make Loylogic a genuinely AI-native company and materially improve how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission can be summarized in five words:

DISCOVER → CHALLENGE → BUILD → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE

* Discover — Get close to our teams and rapidly understand how our most important work actually gets done.
* Challenge — Identify unnecessary work, bottlenecks and complexity. Determine what can be stopped, simplified, automated or fundamentally redesigned.
* Build — Personally prototype AI agents, automations and AI-enabled workflows rather than simply recommending what somebody else should build.
* Implement — Work with our functional teams and Technology to turn successful prototypes into solutions that become part of everyday work.
* Measure — Demonstrate what changed: capacity created, cycle times reduced, quality improved, revenue opportunities enabled, costs avoided and other measurable business outcomes.

***How we think about AI and work***

We don’t assume that every problem needs an AI agent.

Before automating an existing process, we want to understand whether that process should exist in its current form at all.

For the processes you work on, we expect you to think along the lines of:

STOP → SIMPLIFY → AUTOMATE/AGENT → BOOST

* Stop: Does this activity actually need to be done?
* Simplify: Can we make the process fundamentally simpler?
* Automate/Agent: Which activities can AI agents or conventional automation perform reliably?
* BOOST: Where should the person keep the work, with AI making them faster, sharper or better informed?
* Where these changes create meaningful additional capacity, you will help quantify that opportunity so functional leadership can determine how it can best be redirected towards higher-value work.

**What you will do**

You will:

* Rapidly map and understand critical workflows across Loylogic.
* Work directly with functional leaders and the people performing the work.
* Identify and prioritise the highest-value AI and process-transformation opportunities.
* Challenge existing processes before automating them.
* Identify activities that can be eliminated, simplified, automated or AI-augmented.
* Personally prototype and build AI agents, automations and internal tools.
* Integrate solutions with existing systems, data and APIs where appropriate.
* Design appropriate human oversight and escalation into AI-enabled workflows.
* Work closely with Technology to move successful prototypes into secure, reliable and scalable production environments.
* Create reusable components and approaches rather than solving every problem from scratch.
* Help teams adopt new workflows and ways of working.
* Measure the impact of implemented solutions.
* Quantify capacity released and identify opportunities for higher-value use of that capacity.
* Maintain a prioritised pipeline of further transformation opportunities.
* Stay close to developments in agentic AI and rapidly experiment with relevant new capabilities.
* We expect you to build, not just recommend.

***What this could look like in practice***

* You might redesign an RFP process so AI handles research, knowledge retrieval and first-draft creation, allowing Sales to spend more time developing the proposition and engaging the client.
* You could reduce the time Customer Success Managers spend preparing client reporting and QBRs, creating additional capacity for performance analysis, upselling and proactive client engagement.
* You might automate elements of supplier onboarding, catalogue enrichment, management reporting, CRM administration, reconciliation, contract analysis or internal knowledge retrieval.
* Sometimes the right answer will be an AI agent.
* Sometimes it will be conventional automation.
* Sometimes it will simply be a much better process.
* And sometimes the answer will be that a human should continue doing the work — but with much better AI support.
* We expect you to understand the difference.

**What you will do**

We are deliberately not looking for an “AI guru.”

We want an energetic, curious, pragmatic and exceptionally resourceful person who enjoys understanding problems, building solutions and getting them into everyday use.

You will probably have around 2–7 years of relevant professional experience, although demonstrated ability matters considerably more to us than years of experience.

***You should bring a combination of:***

* Strong business-process and problem-solving skills.
* Practical experience applying generative AI and LLMs to real business problems.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents and automated workflows.
* Ability to work with APIs, structured data and business systems.
* Working knowledge of Python or comparable scripting/development capabilities.
* Experience with modern automation/orchestration platforms and AI development tools.
* Understanding of RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompting and agentic architectures.
* An understanding of when human oversight is required in AI-enabled workflows.
* Enough technical depth to build independently while recognizing when enterprise engineering support is required.
* Strong commercial judgement and an ability to prioritize according to business value.
* Excellent communication skills and an ability to understand unfamiliar business areas quickly.
* A strong bias towards experimentation, prototyping and shipping.
* Experience in loyalty is not required. Experience in a fast-moving technology company, SaaS business, marketplace, fintech, scale-up, AI company or entrepreneurial environment would be particularly relevant.

***How you think***

When someone explains a complicated process, your instinct is to ask: “Can you show me how you actually do this today?”

* You don’t automatically assume AI is the answer.
* You first understand the problem, challenge the process and determine the best way of doing the work. Then you build.
* You are equally comfortable discussing a business problem with the CEO or COO, sitting with someone in Finance to understand a reconciliation process, or spending the afternoon building and testing an agent yourself.
* You like autonomy, speed and accountability.

***What this role is not***

This is not a Chief AI Officer role.

* It is not primarily about producing AI strategies, PowerPoint presentations, running innovation workshops or managing large transformation programs.
* Nor is success measured by how many AI agents we deploy.
* This is a hands-on role focused on redesigning work and delivering measurable business outcomes, using AI and automation wherever they are the best tools for the job.

***What success looks like***

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to have developed a practical understanding of the highest-value transformation opportunities across Loylogic, created a prioritized pipeline, redesigned several meaningful workflows and already built and deployed the first AI-enabled solutions.

From there, we will measure success through tangible outcomes including:

* Productivity gained • cycle times reduced • quality improved • commercial capacity created • scalability increased • costs avoided or reduced • employee adoption • measurable revenue opportunities enabled
* Ultimately, we want to combine great people, better processes and increasingly capable AI so that Loylogic can achieve materially more with the organization we have.

**What we offer**

Loylogic is an international business with colleagues, clients and partners located across the world. We combine global scale with an entrepreneurial culture in which people are encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge established thinking and take ownership of meaningful outcomes.

You will join a business shaping the future of AI-powered rewards and engagement, working with recognized global brands and sophisticated loyalty programs across multiple industries and markets. Our goodies for you

Our benefits include:

* Highly-attractive bonus scheme
* Competitive salary dependent on experience
* Hybrid working model (mix of office and home office)
* Own points-based incentive program

And many more benefits.

title: Generative AI Quality Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
**Agentic AI flow testing**
and
**RAG pipeline validation**
to
**AI safety, test automation**
, and
**performance & reliability engineering**
.
  
  
You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
**safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready**
at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Agentic AI Testing
  
  

* Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing
  
  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.

Test Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.

**AI Safety & Security Testing**

* Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:

+ Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.

Performance & Reliability Testing
  
  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

Lead AI Architect — you will work alongside them daily, and you are expected to push back when a design will not survive contact with production
  
  
**Works with:**
The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflows, PRDs and quality bar for the business functions in scope
  
  
**Also partners with**
QAD engineering teams, Data & Platform Engineering, Security & GRC, and external system integrators
  
  
**Scope:**
Foundational engineering hire. Expect to set the engineering standard, mentor subsequent hires, and review partner-delivered code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Building AI and agentic workflows**

* Build production AI and agentic workflows end to end — from PRD and architecture through implementation, evaluation, release and iteration in production.
* Design and implement agent orchestration: multi-step flows, tool and API invocation, planning and routing, state and memory, retries, fallbacks, timeouts and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Make the judgement call on deterministic control flow versus model-driven control flow — and default to the former wherever it produces the same outcome more reliably and more cheaply.
* Integrate with enterprise systems — ERP, CRM, support, services delivery, knowledge and data platforms — including systems with imperfect APIs and imperfect data.

**Retrieval and context engineering**

* Own the retrieval stack: corpus onboarding, document parsing, chunking strategy, embedding selection, hybrid lexical and vector search, reranking, metadata filtering and query transformation.
* Implement permission-aware retrieval so that a user or an agent can only ever retrieve what that identity is entitled to see — non-negotiable in an enterprise context.
* Handle freshness and incremental indexing so that retrieval reflects the state of the business rather than a snapshot from onboarding day.
* Measure retrieval quality explicitly and treat it as a tunable subsystem with its own metrics, not as an assumption.

**Model selection, tuning and evaluation**

* Select, tune and route models across tiers based on measured quality, latency and cost — not on reputation or recency.
* Own prompt engineering, versioning, structured output and context strategy as versioned, tested artefacts under source control.
* Apply fine-tuning, adapters or distillation only where evidence shows the return justifies the operating burden — and be able to make that argument either way.
* Build the evaluation harness: golden datasets, offline evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression suites running in CI, and online quality monitoring with structured feedback capture.
* Work with the Engagement Specialists to turn a business quality bar into measurable criteria — and be honest when a workflow does not clear it.

**The reusable component library**

* Design, build and maintain the shared component library — SDKs, shared services, templates, reference implementations and documentation — that both internal engineers and partner pods build against.
* Treat internal engineers and SI teams as customers of your library: versioning, backwards compatibility, examples, and documentation good enough that people use it without asking you.
* Review partner-delivered code and designs for conformance, quality and maintainability.

**Production engineering and operations**

* Meet explicit latency and cost budgets per workflow, using caching, batching, streaming, model tiering and prompt efficiency.
* Build for graceful degradation: provider outages, rate limits, backpressure, partial failures and safe fallbacks.
* Implement observability for non-deterministic systems — full step-level tracing, token and cost telemetry, quality dashboards, and a triage path for incidents where nothing crashed but the output was wrong.
* Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment promotion, secret and credential handling, and testing discipline for everything the CoE ships.
* Participate in the operational support model for live AI workflows, including post-incident review and remediation.

**Craft and team**

* Set the engineering standard for the CoE and raise it as the team grows.
* Mentor subsequent engineering hires and partner engineers.
* Document decisions and trade-offs so that the next engineer inherits reasoning, not just code.

**Qualifications**
**What we are looking for**
**Essential**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years building and operating production LLM or GenAI systems — systems with real users and real operating cost, not notebooks or proofs of concept.
* Excellent Python, plus working competence in at least one other language (TypeScript, Go, Java or similar).
* Genuine production retrieval experience — you have built a RAG or hybrid search system, measured it, found it wanting, and improved it.
* Agent orchestration experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, Strands, CrewAI or equivalent — together with the judgement to know when a framework is the wrong answer.
* Strong AWS and/or GCP experience, including managed AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) alongside core compute, serverless, networking, IAM and managed data services.
* API design and enterprise integration, including authentication and authorisation patterns — OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, service-to-service authentication, and delegated or on-behalf-of access.
* Containerisation, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or equivalent), CI/CD and real testing discipline.
* Evaluation rigour — you can define what “good” means numerically for a subjective task, defend the definition, and act on the result.
* Cost and latency awareness as a design instinct, not an afterthought raised by finance.
* Clear written communication — design notes, documentation and honest status.
* Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in an early-stage function.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Vector and hybrid search infrastructure at production scale — OpenSearch, pgvector, Vertex AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar.
* Evaluation and observability tooling — LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, Braintrust, Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent.
* Multi-tenant SaaS engineering, and the data isolation discipline that comes with it.
* ERP, manufacturing or supply chain data experience.
* Classical ML and MLOps background — feature stores, model registries, monitoring and drift.
* Fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, or model serving and optimisation.
* Experience building internal platforms or SDKs consumed by other engineers.
* Open-source contribution in the AI engineering ecosystem.

**The technical environment**
A predominantly AWS estate with a meaningful GCP footprint, multi-tenant SaaS products, ERP and manufacturing data, and a heterogeneous set of enterprise systems across CRM, support, services delivery, marketing and data platforms. Engineering capacity is a mix of internal team and external implementation partners.
  
  
The AI toolchain is not fixed. You will help select it — and then live with the consequences, which is the correct incentive.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a prompt engineering role. Prompting is one component of a system that also has retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, infrastructure and an operating cost.
* Not a research scientist role. We are not training foundation models. We are shipping reliable systems on top of them.
* Not a specification-writing role. You will build, and you will read partner code line by line.
* Not a role where quality is somebody else’s problem. If it goes to production, you own how well it works.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months**

* The first prioritised workflow in production or at production readiness, with a working evaluation harness behind it.
* Baseline engineering standards operating — repository structure, CI/CD, environments, tracing, secret handling.
* A shared understanding with the architect and the Engagement Specialists of what “good” means, expressed as numbers.

**First 6 months**

* The first version of the reusable component library in use — by you, by internal engineers, and by at least one partner pod.
* Multiple workflows live, with quality, latency and cost per transaction instrumented and visible.
* Regression evaluation running in CI, so a change that degrades quality fails before release rather than in front of a customer.

**First 12 months**

* Demonstrably lower build cost and cycle time for each successive workflow, attributable to reuse.
* A production estate that is operable by the team — monitored, documented, supported, and not dependent on any one person.
* Partner-delivered code that meets the same standard as internal code, because the standard and the review are real.

**How We Assess**

* Technical conversation on a production AI system you built — architecture, evaluation approach, what broke, what you would do differently.
* Practical exercise in retrieval or agent orchestration, discussed rather than graded in isolation.
* Code and design review — you review something of ours, we review something of yours.
* Collaboration interview with the CoE and a functional stakeholder.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

We are looking for an engineer who understands that
**AI is a means to a business outcome—not the outcome itself**
and can turn promising capabilities into reliable systems that create measurable value.
  
  
**Top 3 Outcomes (first 12 months)**

* Build and operationalize agentic SDLC capabilities: Architect and deliver production-grade AI workflows that materially improve how Nextiva engineers design, build, test, review, deploy, operate, and maintain software, with measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness.
* Establish a scalable internal AI platform: Develop reusable architecture, services, infrastructure, patterns, and guardrails that enable AI-powered workflows to move reliably from experimentation into secure, observable, production-scale operation.
* Deliver measurable business impact through AI and automation: Identify and execute high-value automation opportunities across engineering and business processes, establishing clear success metrics and demonstrating tangible improvements in productivity, quality, velocity, cost, or customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows across the SDLC and broader business processes.
* Design scalable internal platform capabilities that enable teams across Nextiva to safely and efficiently adopt AI-powered automation.
* Own solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability, security, scaling, and ongoing operation.
* Build robust integrations between AI models, agents, developer tooling, internal platforms, enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and engineering workflows.
* Apply strong software engineering principles to AI systems, including modular architecture, testing, reliability, performance, maintainability, and fault tolerance.
* Design approaches for AI evaluation, observability, quality measurement, failure handling, and continuous improvement in production.
* Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership rather than technology trends.
* Work deeply within GCP and/or AWS, designing cloud-native architectures and infrastructure capable of supporting secure, reliable, scalable production workloads.
* Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems.
* Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent architectures, and developer technologies to determine where they can create meaningful value for Nextiva.
* Provide Staff-level technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams.
* Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results.

**Requirements**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes.
* Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems.
* Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as Java, Python, Go, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions beyond prototypes into deployment, operationalization, monitoring, security, reliability, and scale.
* Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems—not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles.
* Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

**Preferred**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic AI systems, multi-step AI workflows, tool-using agents, or autonomous/semi-autonomous engineering workflows.
* Experience applying AI to developer productivity, software engineering, code generation, testing, code review, incident management, or other stages of the SDLC.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity platforms, or enterprise automation capabilities.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, model/agent observability, prompt and context management, retrieval architectures, and production AI quality measurement.
* Experience spanning traditional software engineering and AI engineering—for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience.
* Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains.

**Tools & Tech Stack**
The Exact Stack Will Evolve As We Select Technologies Based On The Problems And Outcomes We Are Solving. Relevant Experience May Include
  
  

* Cloud: GCP and/or AWS
* Languages: Java, Python, Go, and/or equivalent production engineering languages

* Platform & Infrastructure: Containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud-native services

**Nextiva DNA**

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:
  
  

* Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. **About you:**

* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.

* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI-specific threats

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.

* Experience with Redis, caching, rate limiting, telemetry, usage analytics, capacity planning, or cost management.
* Experience with pytest, Vitest, Playwright, contract testing, integration testing, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience in semiconductor, advanced computing, developer platform, or enterprise engineering environments.

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Location: Pune, India
  
  
**About GF**
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
  
  
Introduction
  
  
GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.
  
  
Your Job
  
  

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 4 to 8 years of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.

title: Senior SAP AI Architect
description:
Senior SAP AI Architect

Location: Anywhere in India

Job Description:

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on SAP AI Architect to lead the strategy, design, and implementation of

next-generation Enterprise AI solutions. In this role, you will be the technical anchor for our AI transformation,

focusing heavily on building intelligent agents and digital assistants.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of deep enterprise architecture knowledge and extensive

hands-on experience deploying AI via both low-code frameworks (e.g., Joule Studio) and pro-code engineering

(e.g., custom LLM orchestration and frameworks) within the SAP BTP ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Agent Orchestration

• End-to-End Agentic AI: Design and deliver architectures that integrate seamlessly with SAP S/4HANA,

SAP SuccessFactors, and non-SAP systems.

• Multi-Agent Systems: Architect workflows using foundational/advanced communication methodologies,

ensuring interoperability via the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.

• Tool Integration: Standardize landscape interaction by implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for

secure internal and external tool interactions.

• AI Governance: Govern the lifecycle using the SAP LeanIX AI Agent Hub to discover, optimize, and manage

enterprise-wide AI capabilities.

Low-Code Assistant Delivery

• Digital Assistants: Build, configure, and seamlessly register corporate digital assistants via Joule Studio in

SAP Build.

• Visual Workflows: Utilize drag-and-drop interfaces to design complex business workflows, managed

runtimes, and automated tasks without traditional code.

Pro-Code AI Engineering

• Custom AI Engines: Develop high-performance AI engines using the SAP Cloud SDK for AI via Python,

Java, or TypeScript.

• Advanced Orchestration: Orchestrate multi-agent behaviors, memory systems, and custom tool-calling

using frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI.

• Cloud Deployments: Deploy containerized custom AI microservices efficiently on cloud runtimes like Kyma

or SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.

Data & Core Infrastructure Integration

• Model Orchestration: Leverage SAP AI Core and the Generative AI Hub to securely orchestrate,

benchmark, and deploy large language models (LLMs).

• Enterprise RAG: Implement advanced retrieval mechanisms using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),

capitalizing on the SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engines.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

Core SAP AI Stack

• SAP Platform: Hands-on mastery of SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry / Kyma), CAP Framework, and SAP

Integration Suite.

• AI Control Plane: In-depth working experience with SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, AI Launchpad, and

Joule.

• Low-Code Toolkit: Complete proficiency in Joule Studio and the SAP Build suite.

Pro-Code & Engineering Frameworks

• Languages: Strong, production-grade programming skills in Python (required) along with Node.js/TypeScript

or Java.

• Orchestration Libraries: Deep practical knowledge of GenAI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain,

LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex).

• Data Tiering: Expert knowledge of Vector Databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and graph

technologies.

Integration & DevOps

• APIs & Protocols: Mastery of OData, REST, Event-Driven Architectures, A2A protocols, and MCP (Model

Context Protocol).

• Cloud Native: Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker containerization, and enterprise CI/CD pipelines.

Experience & Education Requirements

• Overall IT Experience: Minimum of 8+ years in enterprise software architecture and engineering.

• AI/SAP Specific Experience: At least 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and deploying

Generative AI or Agentic AI systems, specifically within an SAP context.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a heavily quantitative field.

• Certifications (Preferred): SAP BTP certifications, SAP AI specialized credentials, or formal cloud platform

architect certifications.
