* You can work with the stakeholders to understand the big picture and work towards it.
* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.


 Must have
   

  

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.
* Technology Selection: Deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for specific needs.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Emerging Technologies: Curiosity and interest in keeping up with emerging data technologies.
* Experience in hybrid environments: cloud \+ on\-prem
* Business Acumen: Understanding of core business processes and how data analytics can drive strategic decision\-making.
* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.
* Mentorship: Ability to mentor and guide junior team members within the data team.


 Education
   

  

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.


 Knowledge
   

  

* Good analytical skills: You feel comfortable working with numbers/data, e.g. collecting and analysing trend graphs, combining the info with insights from ERP and previous site visits to come to a sound conclusion.
* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.


 Personality requirements
   

  

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)
* Open minded; expect the unexpected (\= stay sceptical when viewing at the data and info)

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

 aiqon is hiring for the Jr. AI Engineer Role. This is an AI \+ Engineering role, not a teaching or research\-only position. You will build AI systems and ship full\-stack product work for industry clients in the USA and Australia.
 



  





 The work is broader than LLM integrations. Depending on the client, you may develop or fine\-tune models for document processing, truck tracking and logistics, computer vision, or similar applied problems, then take those models into production.
 



  





 On a typical week, you might train or adapt a document\-extraction model, work on a tracking pipeline, integrate an LLM into a workflow, then jump to a React or API change or a production bug. We need people who can work across applied AI and software engineering, not just one or the other.
 



 This role is fully remote. You will support clients in the USA and Australia, so overlapping hours with those time zones are required.

* Develop, adapt, and ship models for applied problems such as document processing, truck tracking and logistics, and similar client use cases, not only LLM integrations.

*Due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Thank you.*

title: Python Lead/Architect
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Python Lead/Architect with deep expertise in Python development, modern web architectures, and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining technical architecture, leading development teams, and delivering scalable enterprise\-grade applications using Python, Django, Flask, FastAPI, and cloud\-native technologies. This role requires a strong blend of hands\-on technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, leadership skills, and experience implementing AI\-powered business solutions.
 



  




* **Role: Python Lead/Architect**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: Between 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Architect and lead the development of enterprise\-scale web applications using Python\-based frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python, Django, Flask, FastAPI, and asynchronous programming frameworks.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices, and event\-driven services.
* Lead integration initiatives with third\-party systems, external platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Design scalable and resilient application architectures leveraging microservices and distributed systems principles.
* Implement Generative AI\-powered solutions and integrate Large Language Models into enterprise workflows.
* Design and build AI\-enabled applications utilizing prompt engineering, intelligent automation, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, DevOps engineers, architects, and product managers to deliver business solutions.
* Define API governance standards, security controls, and development best practices.
* Optimize applications for scalability, performance, security, availability, and maintainability.
* Design messaging and event\-processing solutions using Kafka, RabbitMQ, and related technologies.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevOps best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and solution design assessments.
* Mentor development teams and provide technical leadership across multiple projects.
* Support production environments, troubleshoot critical issues, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, AI trends, cloud\-native architectures, and industry best practices.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 12 to 17 years of software development experience with extensive expertise in Python application development.

* Proven experience designing and implementing large\-scale enterprise applications and solution architectures.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles, object\-oriented design, and design patterns.
* Experience developing event\-driven and asynchronous applications.

* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and OpenAPI/Swagger\-based services.

* Expertise in database design, optimization, and development using PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, or equivalent databases.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and enterprise business systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployments.
* Strong cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of Generative AI technologies, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience building AI\-powered enterprise solutions and integrating AI services into business applications.
* Strong understanding of security best practices, authentication, authorization, and secure API development.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum\-based development environments.
* Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities.
